title: Narrative Economics: The Field Guide Culture Workers Needed
audience: Growing professionals and seasoned operators who need a citeable briefing on why stories move markets, careers, and institutions.
metaDescription: A field guide to narrative economics — how contagious stories shape markets, cancellations, and cultural booms — built for people who brief others.
angle: Translate Shiller’s framework into Artometrics desk language: definition → mechanism → measurement → case tiles (crypto, pandemic, MeToo timing, meme stocks) → how to use it in outreach without becoming a guru.
